hero.h1: Faucet Repair and Installation in Ravenswood, Chicago
hero.sub: A two-handle faucet that drips, a kitchen faucet with weak flow or new fixtures for a renovation. We repair and install faucets and fixtures in Ravenswood homes and two-flats. Our office is on Ravenswood Avenue.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in branded red leather gloves installing a new chrome faucet on a white bathroom sink with an adjustable wrench

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.h2: When to Call About a Faucet

tiles.body: Worn washers, seats or a cartridge.
A clogged aerator or old pipe.

bodies: We repair and install kitchen faucets, from older two-handle models to modern pull-downs.
We replace worn shutoffs and supply lines at the same time.
We handle drains, shutoffs, dishwasher hookups, ice maker lines and [garbage disposals](/chicago-ravenswood/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Renovating? We'll handle the plumbing for a new layout.

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets and showerheads, and check the shutoffs while we're there.
Replacing several fixtures? We'll plan one visit.

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Ravenswood Homes
blocks.intro: Older homes mean older fixtures and valves.

items.body: Washers and seats wear and drip. Many can be rebuilt.
We replace them during the repair.
Can restrict flow to a new faucet.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Plenty of Ravenswood homes still have original or older two-handle faucets, some with real character. When they drip, the fix is usually new washers and seats, not a new faucet. We carry common parts and can source others. If a faucet is too worn to rebuild, we'll help you find a replacement that fits the existing holes and the style of the room.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Faucet Work
blocks.body: Rebuilding an old two-handle faucet is usually quick. Replacing a faucet takes longer when old fittings are seized or the shutoffs need replacing. Wall-mount faucets can involve the pipes in the wall. We check first and quote one flat price.

items.q: Can you rebuild my old two-handle faucet?
items.answer: Often, if parts are available. If not, we'll recommend a replacement that fits.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, if it's complete and fits the sink.
If they're original or stiff, yes.

items.q: Why is my new faucet's flow weak?
items.answer: Usually debris in the aerator, sometimes old supply pipe.

items.q: Can you replace a wall-mount faucet?
items.answer: Yes, though the supply pipes in the wall may need work too.

items.q: Can you install a new faucet on an old porcelain sink?
items.answer: Usually, if the holes and spacing match. We'll check first.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
